lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Thirty-two winters ago, the frost came|back to Evenmead. Nothing grew. Again.
lines.text: Thirty-two winters ago, the frost came back to Evenmead. Nothing grew. Again.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: They say I was born the year nothing grew.|I won't let there be two.
lines.text: They say I was born the year nothing grew. I won't let there be two.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: Seed in the snow, little one?|The whole village is laughing at you.
lines.text: Seed in the snow, little one? The whole village is laughing at you.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: My mother did it. In spring it came|up green. Help me keep the wolves off.
lines.text: My mother did it. In spring it came up green. Help me keep the wolves off.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: Fine. I'll take the well.|The wolves always come to the well.
lines.text: Fine. I'll take the well. The wolves always come to the well.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: When the sun went down, the frost bit|through everything that was not covered.
lines.text: When the sun went down, the frost bit through everything that was not covered.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Cover the gardens! Sit on them if you have to!
lines.text: Cover the gardens! Sit on them if you have to!

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: Wolves off the north ridge.|Thin ones. Hungry ones.
lines.text: Wolves off the north ridge. Thin ones. Hungry ones.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: See? It fights back.|Things that grow always fight back.
lines.text: See? It fights back. Things that grow always fight back.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: No. No, no. I'll plant it|again. Next year. I will.
lines.text: No. No, no. I'll plant it again. Next year. I will.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: Colder than last night.|The river froze to the bottom.
lines.text: Colder than last night. The river froze to the bottom.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Then we'll be warmer than the river.
lines.text: Then we'll be warmer than the river.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: On the longest night, the pack's|old leader came down from the ridge.
lines.text: On the longest night, the pack's old leader came down from the ridge.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: Old Whitepelt. I've hunted him nine|winters. He's never been this hungry.
lines.text: Old Whitepelt. I've hunted him nine winters. He's never been this hungry.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: Nine winters. And a girl with|a seed sack beats me to him.
lines.text: Nine winters. And a girl with a seed sack beats me to him.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: And then, one grey morning,|the snow began to turn to water.
lines.text: And then, one grey morning, the snow began to turn to water.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: A sapling, coaxed through|the frost. In this cold?
lines.text: A sapling, coaxed through the frost. In this cold?

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: It wants to grow. It only|needs someone to wait with it.
lines.text: It wants to grow. It only needs someone to wait with it.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Show me.
lines.text: Show me.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: ...Show me again.
lines.text: ...Show me again.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: She did. For twenty years, until he was gone.
lines.text: She did. For twenty years, until he was gone.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: I'm sorry... I couldn't keep them warm.
lines.text: I'm sorry... I couldn't keep them warm.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Nothing grew. Nothing at all.
lines.text: Nothing grew. Nothing at all.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: I'm fine! Bitten. Fine. Keep planting.
lines.text: I'm fine! Bitten. Fine. Keep planting.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Twelve years ago he sent for me one|last time. Torvald too. Only us.
lines.text: Twelve years ago he sent for me one last time. Torvald too. Only us.
